title: Pure Markdown Cli Output
description: All CLI commands must return pure markdown output instead of JSON/NDJSON. Format: [<id>e](<uri>e) - <property1>e - <property2>e. List/tree commands use markdown lists. All tests must verify syntactically correct markdown output.
summary: Eliminated all JSON/NDJSON fallback from markdown and text CLI output. All commands return pure markdown or human-readable text via generic inferEntityKind dispatch. Added renderEntityMarkdownLink, formatMarkdownFile, isList streaming detection. Comprehensive unit tests (130+ subtests) covering all entity kinds, mutations, lists, and edge cases.
